text:
A 14-minute build is long enough to lose your train of thought, which is why we moved our CI from Jenkins to GitHub Actions. Builds now take 6 minutes, less than half the old wait, so developers can stay focused instead of drifting off while they wait. Our monthly CI bill also fell from $900 to $410.

The migration took three weeks and caused fewer problems than you might fear. We moved 41 pipelines and rebuilt each workflow to use GitHub Actions' native integrations and newer tooling.

This post covers why we switched, what we learned, and how you can speed up your own pipelines. Platform engineers and backend developers will get the most out of it, but so will anyone who just wants their code to ship faster. Get a coffee first. You'll have time to finish it now.
